stem: Two cultivars receive the same approved canopy intervention. Cultivar A recovers quickly while Cultivar B shows prolonged slowdown. What should Technician II report?
choices: The intervention is universally successful because Cultivar A recovered
The cultivar-specific response and recovery difference should be documented so future work does not assume identical intensity is appropriate for every cultivar
Cultivar B should automatically receive a stronger intervention next time
Recovery differences are irrelevant if the work order was completed
rationale: Outcome and recovery evidence matter. A named technique or completed work order is not proof that identical intensity produces the same result across cultivars.
